title: Source Strategy Taxonomy
description: Declares the abstract visual source domain for a timeline moment. Does not specify concrete files or queries.

values.description: On-camera presenter (Marcel) is the primary visual anchor.
Property footage (interiors, private rooms, balcony) is primary.
Macro-location, neighborhood landmarks, or urban proximity evidence is primary.
Graphic / typographic / conceptual communication is primary.
Emotional / aspirational use of spaces is primary.
Atmospheric or environmental framing is primary.
Multiple sources intentionally co-exist in the visual strategy.
Inherits and sustains the active visual source from the previous beat.
Visual source strategy pending further contextual resolution.
